name: Admin Diagnostic JSON Import
description: Admin imports a JSON blob from the JSON tab of /panel/diagnostics/:id/edit, either by pasting into the textarea or uploading a .json file (FileReader → textarea). Parse runs on every input; validation requires a root object with an array `sections`. A preview strip shows client name, section count, and formatted investment. Aplicar JSON runs PATCH /update/ for metadata first, then POST /sections/bulk-update/; success emits an inline toast and resyncs the pricing/radiography forms. Errors surface inline and abort the apply.
